operating_notes.text: QIP proceeds utilized stood at ₹380.80 Cr out of ₹3,000 Cr total issue size as of March 31, 2026.
Commissioned S3 Unit-II EHV switchgear manufacturing facility in Nashik with an annual capacity of 7,200 units.
Proposed capacity addition of 600 Eq Units by FY30 with ₹35.17 Cr investment.
Q1FY27 consolidated results reflect semiconductor segment impact of ₹43 Cr.
QIP proceeds utilized stood at ₹502.65 Cr out of ₹3,000 Cr total issue size as of June 30, 2026.
Axiro Semiconductor Private Limited agreed to acquire 100% stake in Tosil Systems Private Limited for ₹16.44 Cr.
Experienced a suspected cyber-event on IT systems with core operations and systems remaining unaffected.
Rolled out first transformer from the new greenfield Sehore plant with initial 10,000 MVA operational capacity out of 45,000 MVA planned.
Board approved capacity expansions for Power Transformers (₹68 Cr), S1 Unit OIP (~₹300 Cr), S3 Unit-II Phase 2 (₹15.31 Cr), and GIS Vilholi (additional ₹9.45 Cr).
GG Tronics received RDSO approval for Kavach 4.0 covering Automatic and Absolute block sections, enabling execution of the ₹433 Cr KAVACH order.

timeline.summary: CG Power received a revisionary tax order for AY 2022-23 with an additional disallowance of ₹21.43 Cr, bringing total claims to ₹236.74 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,441.76 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹365.49 Cr.
CG Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹12,418 Cr and PAT of ₹1,197 Cr, with order backlog rising 61% YoY to ₹17,107 Cr.
CG Power reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹3,129 Cr and PAT of ₹412 Cr, capping a record fiscal year with an order backlog of ₹15,719 Cr.
On May 6, 2026, CG Power released the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹380.80 crore utilized from QIP proceeds.
CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited uploaded the audio recording of its conference call with analysts and investors on May 6, 2026, at its website.
CG Power commissioned its S3 Unit-II EHV switchgear manufacturing facility in Nashik with an investment of ₹39.49 Cr on June 4, 2026.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,280.81 Cr (+14.0% YoY), net profit ₹308.28 Cr (+15.5% YoY).
CG Power announced statutory auditor SRBC's resignation effective August 14, 2026, to align with holding company TII's auditor network.
On July 24, 2026, CG Power reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,281 Cr (+14% YoY) and PAT of ₹308 Cr (+16% YoY), and announced auditor transition.
On July 24, 2026, CG Power released the Monitoring Agency Report for Q1FY27 showing ₹502.65 Cr utilized out of ₹3,000 Cr QIP proceeds.
CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited uploaded the audio recording of its conference call with analysts and investors held on July 24, 2026, on its website.
CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited’s 89th AGM on July 24, 2026, passed all five resolutions with 100% shareholder approval via e-voting.
CG Power noted the resignation of statutory auditors M/s. S R B C & CO LLP effective August 14, 2026, to align with holding company TII's auditor network.
On August 17, 2026, CG Power's subsidiary Axiro Semiconductor entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Tosil Systems Private Limited for ₹16.44 Cr.
On August 18, 2026, CG Power reported a suspected cyber-event on its IT systems with core operations remaining unaffected.
CG Power rolled out the first transformer from its new ₹792 Cr greenfield facility in Sehore, Madhya Pradesh on 4th September 2026.
CG Power received a stay on its revised ₹215.59 Cr income tax demand pending appeal, subject to a ₹30 Cr deposit in instalments.
CG Power shareholders approved the appointment of Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor via postal ballot on 25th September 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,801.54 Cr (+30.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹412.04 Cr.
Audio recording of conference call with analysts and investors held on Friday, 23rd October 2026 uploaded on the company's website.
GG Tronics received final RDSO approval for Kavach 4.0, enabling the execution of its ₹433 Cr order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works.

upcoming_events.description: Expected completion of Tosil Systems Private Limited acquisition
